empirical_grid_source: Ma et al., ICML 2024, Appendix E.1
selection_rule: Fixed Ma24 Appendix-E.1 parameter values; applied consistently across epsilon values and seeds; no response scaling
theorem_reference_retained: paper_reference_parameters() still provides T=ceil(log N), k'=8k, eta=1, tau1=tau2=sqrt(log N) for mechanism diagnostics only
caveat: Core estimator is Zhu24 Algorithm 2. Parameters are an empirical Ma24-grid point, not Zhu24 Theorem-7 numerical constants.

qualification_grid.purpose: Optional synthetic parameter-grid diagnostics; does not change the selected profile
qualification_grid.selection_objective: mean relative L2 coefficient error on synthetic evaluation samples
qualification_grid.provenance: every point is contained in Ma24 Appendix-E.1 reported LDPIHT grid
